English:
Heya, <Suzu>. You should
enjoy yourself and try laughing sometimes.
Do you enjoy yourself every day?
Oh, of course! Of course I do!

Someone told me that you were an
idiot, but enjoyed yourself all the same.

Aha! It had to be YOU! You've been poisoning
this young girl's mind with your lies, huh!?
Come back here! I'm gonna barbecue you!
Hmhm... Oh, was that a laugh?
